info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Document Submission API
info.description: The Loan Application Document Submission API enables users to upload essential documents for loan applications seamlessly. This API is crucial for financial institutions and service providers who handle loan processing, ensuring that required documentation is collected efficiently. By integrating this API, developers can streamline the loan application process for their clients, enhancing user experience and adherence to compliance requirements. Typical consumers of this API include loan origination systems and financial application platforms seeking to automate and simplify document submissions.

post.summary: Upload a document associated with a loan application.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to upload documents that are associated with a specific loan application identified by its ID. Ensure the document meets the required format and size specifications prior to upload.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit documents related to the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required documents are included and follow the correct format as specified in the associated schema.
